evidence: Walking the Haast to Paringa Cattle Track is a three-day journey and you will need to be prepared to stay in huts along the route.
Access to the north end of the track is signposted approximately 40 km northeast of Haast on SH6 at the Windbag Saddle.

Eventually the track swings to the north and follows a fence-line towards Coppermine Creek where the DOC hut is on the “true right” of the creek and the furthest of the three huts. It is another two-hour walk to the highway.
The sound end of the track is marked by a gate just south of the Waita River Bridge about 11 km north of Haast Junction.

doubts: Start: F2 ('where an unnamed track meets HAAST HIGHWAY') lies near Windbag Creek and Blowfly Hut, which fits the north-end access at Windbag Saddle and the initial detour track, but it is an unnamed track so not certain. End: F1 ('where Haast to Paringa Cattle Track meets HAAST HIGHWAY') taken as the south-end gate near Waita River Bridge. The page describes the track north to south and does not say whether the reverse is usual. Blowfly Hut is 15 min from a junction across a swing bridge, with the onward turn-off just before the hut, so it may be a short detour rather than directly on the line. No total distance is given.
